title: Mount or Dismount a Tenant on a Business Central Server Instance

facts.text: Server instance must be configured for multitenancy to mount and dismount tenants
Open administration tool and verify server instance is running before mounting tenant
Expand server instance item in left pane and select Tenants
Choose Mount Tenant in Actions pane and fill parameters including database details
Dismount tenant by right-clicking tenant entry and selecting Dismount Tenant
Mount-NAVTenant cmdlet can mount tenant without running server instance
Encryption keys automatically applied when specifying SQL Server authentication credentials
